decisions.reason: The firm has publicly committed to this closely related service with a dedicated page, making management likely to persist to justify prior investments.
Despite limited website promotion, the sunk costs across several models and its centrality to the firm's open GIS direction lead management to continue the product line.
Its dedicated page and close fit with existing identity offerings create visible commitment that escalation of commitment makes hard to reverse.
As a newly launched workshop with a dedicated page, management is likely to give it more time and preserve the public commitment before considering withdrawal.
